Recorded responses from six public STAC APIs, one directory each.

Produced by ../record.jl on 2026-09-02:

    julia --project=. test/fixtures/record.jl [endpoint ...]

Per directory:

  root.json         the landing page
  conformance.json  the /conformance document its `conformance` link points at
  collections.json  the first page of /collections
  search-1.json     POST /search with {collections, datetime, limit: 2}
  search-2.json     the request search-1.json's `next` link describes
  requests.json     the (method, href, body) that produced each of the above

test/FixtureIO.jl replays requests.json: a request that does not match one of those four
tuples exactly raises, so a client that formats its search differently than what is recorded
here fails rather than being answered anyway.

Every response body is verbatim except collections.json, whose `collections` array is
truncated to its first two entries and re-serialized; the CMR and Planetary Computer
deployments list hundreds of collections and the whole page is megabytes.

The six endpoints cover the three paging shapes the spec permits:

  planetary-computer, cdse, itslive   pgstac: POST `next` with the whole body plus a `token`
  earth-search, landsatlook           stac-server: POST `next`, `merge: false`, own body
  cmr-lpcloud                         a GET `next` carrying `cursor=`

and the two count shapes: `numberMatched` (earth-search, landsatlook, itslive), the
deprecated `context.matched` (cmr-lpcloud), and none at all (planetary-computer, cdse).
